topic: Infra team coordinating a license check for acme/deepwiki-bot

messages.text: FYI: The DeepWiki integration PR references acme/deepwiki-bot but maintainers weren't sure about the repo license. Flagging here so legal isn't surprised.
Do you have the repo URL for that bot? I want to check the license quickly before we merge.
Also, FYI I bumped into @dina in the hall; she said she'll take a look this afternoon.
Repo is acme/deepwiki-bot. @dina, can you confirm whether it's MIT or Apache (or something else)?
Link: https://github.com/acme/deepwiki-bot — sending it here so it's easy to copy.
I remember we looked at this a while back and thought it was MIT, but the README has been edited since. I'll pull the repo and check the LICENSE file.
Who's bringing snacks for Friday's gathering?
Got it — I'll ping the infra channel and ask Dina to paste the license output when she has it.
Also, unrelated — does anyone want to join a trivia night tonight?
If it turns out to be MIT we're fine to proceed. If it's something incompatible we'll need legal sign-off — heads up.
Can someone run a quick license-check on acme/deepwiki-bot and paste the output here? That would save time.
The CI flaked on me this morning, unrelated to the PR — I'll rerun.
Thanks — I'll hold off merging until we have that confirmation in infra.
